description:
Cast Peregrin Took by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrin Took enters, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Peregrin Took with haste plus at least one additional token due to Peregrin Took's effect.
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}.
When Kirol enters, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, use the ability of Citanul Hierophants to tap one of the Peregrin Took tokens, adding {1}.
Activate Kirol by tapping two creatures, copying Cadric's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Cadric's trigger, creating at least eight tokens due to the multiple copies of Peregrin Took.
Holding priority, use the ability of Citanul Hierophants to tap one of the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 6.
